sources.title: ByteDance Seed
sources.snippet: The ByteDance Seed team was established in 2023, dedicated to discovering new approaches to general intelligence, pushing the boundaries of AI. The team's research areas include LLM, speech, vision, world models, infrastructure, AI Infra, and next-generation AI interactions. The team operates labs in China, Singapore, the United States, and other locations.

sources.title: cobalt/README.md at main · OSU-NLP-Group/cobalt · GitHub
sources.snippet: Cobalt outperforms two multi-turn online RL baselines based on GRPO and VeRPO, and substantially improves R1-Distill 8B and Qwen3 8B by up to 9.0 and 6.2 absolute Pass@1 scores on LiveCodeBench. Also, we analyze LLMs' in-context reward hacking behaviors and augment Cobalt training with perturbed trajectories to mitigate this issue.
